messages:
Carmen: Elmwood15B landed on staging (int6 quant). Running the standard gen/summarize eval and seeing OOMs on coldstart and a ~6 ROUGE-1 drop vs fp16.
Liam: OOMs on which machine type? logs?
Carmen: 4xA100 40GB per node. Snapshot of the oom trace:
Carmen: ```
E n v : CUDA OOM when allocating 1.2 GiB
Stack: runtime/alloc.cc:245 kv_cache_reserve -> slab_alloc
``` 
Anika: That allocation path points to KV cache growth + slab fragmentation. Did you enable prefetch? 
Carmen: Yes prefetch: true in the staging profile. Batch-size default 8, max_new_tokens 512.
Ravi: Two quick experiments: 1) disable prefetch, 2) reduce max_new_tokens -> 256 and soft-reserve KV to 0.6 of max. 
Liam: Agree. Also try lowering microbatch to 4 and enabling slab-compactor: true
Carmen: Pushed a canary config:
Carmen: ```json
{"prefetch":false,"microbatch":4,"max_new_tokens":256,"kv_soft_reserve":0.6,"slab_compactor":true}
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for elmwood15b-int6 on staging (canary id c-179)
Anika: After patch - memory pressure dropped and coldstart OOM disappeared on 10/12 runs. Perf: latency +12% p95; cost lower. Quality: rouge-1 recovered to +/-1.2 vs fp16.
Ravi: Nice. What's the remaining gap? consider running a short eval sweep with temperature and top_p matched for int6.
Carmen: Running eval now across summarization and instruction-following. If stable, will roll default max_new_tokens to 256 and document the slab/kv guidance.
Liam: Can you add a small note to the model onboarding checklist? put the canary id and config.
Carmen: Done: added checklist entry and linked the canary logs: https://staging.logs/elmwood/c-179
Anika: Ack. Next: get perf baseline for 1) warm steady-state and 2) coldstart tail to decide if we need an extra reservation per host.
Ravi: I'll follow up with a short bench script to compare int6 vs fp16 on ROUGE and latency. 
Carmen: Thanks all :thumbsup:
